title: Infographic — God will never leave me (toddler hand)
prompt: Bright cheerful children's Bible activity handout illustration. Close-up front view of a toddler's open right hand and wrist, chocolate-brown skin, hand filling the frame. Bold text printed on the palm reads 'Hebrews 13:5' in large bright centred letters. Each finger labelled from thumb to pinky with one word: thumb = 'God', index = 'will', middle = 'never', ring = 'leave', pinky = 'me' — each word in bold rounded font in a different bright colour: red, orange, yellow, green, blue. Soft pastel yellow background. Flat digital art, clean bold outlines, child-friendly typography. No other text or decoration.
